summary: The extraction is accurate. The bound expressions, the high-probability qualifiers, the adversary type in each setting and the provenance all match Theorems 2.3, 3.1 and 4.1. The strengthened Freedman inequality (Theorem 2.2) is a technical concentration result and was rightly left out, and the appendix restatements (Theorems B.16 and C.11) add no new results.
